description: Experience the quintessential coastal lifestyle in Sausalito's highly desirable Spring Valley neighborhood with this impeccably maintained duplex, a rare offering held by the same family for over 50 years, that seamlessly blends historic charm with thoughtful modern upgrades, all while boasting lovely views of Richardson Bay. This property is defined by its versatile living options across two identical units (Upper 124 / Lower 122), each featuring bright 2 bedroom/one bathroom open floor plans, a cozy fireplace, and spacious living areas that flow directly into private view decks, with updated kitchens in both units that include a breakfast bar and modern appliances such as a dishwasher and built-in microwave, plus a gas range in the lower Unit 122. Residents benefit from exceptional convenience with additional amenities like shared laundry facilities, dedicated off-street parking, and secure storage for each unit, all situated in an iconic community with unbeatable connectivity to the Bay Area and easy access to Sausalito's vibrant waterfront amenities, including Schoonmaker Beach and nearby green spaces like Langendorf Park (located directly across the street) and Dunphy Park, making it an ideal opportunity for an owner-occupant or investor, especially since the Upper Unit (124) is ready for immediate occupancy- projected rent is $4k/mo. Utilities are separately metered. Lower unit (122) is occupied by long term tenant (please do not disturb).
